question: Which twelve-syllabled form of Viṣṇu is invoked to protect the northern direction?
premises: A twelve-syllabled form is identified with Viṣṇu
Constant protection of the speaker is requested
inference: The twelve-syllabled Viṣṇu always protects the speaker in the north.
plain_english: May Viṣṇu in his twelve-syllabled form always protect me in the north.
